cases.name: library-added-with-a-taken-id
cases.covers: A LIBRARY_ADDED for an id already present replaces the library and appends the id to the order again.

cases.name: library-removed
cases.covers: Removing a library drops it, its order entries and its listed assets.

cases.name: library-removed-unknown
cases.covers: An unknown library id returns the same state.

cases.name: library-removed-with-missing-assets
cases.covers: Deleting a listed asset that is already gone is harmless; an asset of another library survives.

cases.name: library-removed-duplicate-order
cases.covers: Every order entry of the id goes.

cases.name: asset-added-to-unknown-library
cases.covers: An asset for an unknown library returns the same state.

cases.name: asset-added-twice
cases.covers: An asset id already present is replaced and listed a second time.

cases.name: asset-removed-unknown
cases.covers: An unknown asset id returns the same state.

cases.name: asset-removed-without-its-library
cases.covers: An asset whose library is gone is deleted and the libraries are left as they are.

cases.name: library-updated-unknown
cases.covers: An update for an unknown library returns the same state.

cases.name: asset-updated-unknown
cases.covers: An update for an unknown asset returns the same state.

cases.name: unknown-action
cases.covers: An action outside the union returns the same state.
